description: Day in the life of a wine girl #winetour  #dayinthelife #fyp #vlog
transcript: Welcome to the day in the life of a wine girly. I started my Monday by going to my bar three class. After it was over I was super sore. It definitely kicked my butt but it was much needed to start a busy Monday. I went home, showered, popped in the car and immediately went to an event. Super gorgeous. I had some fire wine, no complaints here. Surrounded by a great group of women in the wine industry. It was lit. We had a great time. Next up on Tuesday I went to breakfast with my wine mentor. Afterwards we took a walk. We had a time a moment was had. That evening a friend invited me to their restaurant. The food was amazing. Champagne was flowing. We had a great time. They had a beautiful piano player. Great singer. It was a lot of fun. Wednesday I held a digital virtual wine tasting. In that evening I got invited to a wine tasting. Great time. I didn't record anything for Thursday but this is Friday. I poured at a 500 person wine event at a baseball stadium. So much fun. We had a time. On Saturdays I pour in a tasting room. This is me preparing for the calm before the storm. It was a super fun crazy day. It was nice weather so the guests were coming in and we had a time. I ended my evening organizing my wine and doing some philosophy study.
